responsibility: Implements the default traversal behavior for the Rust frontend AST visitor framework. It defines `DefaultASTVisitor` methods that recursively walk the children of crate, path, expression, item, macro, pattern, statement, and type nodes while handling attributes and optional substructures, and also provides the context-stack specializations of `ContextualASTVisitor` for major enclosing constructs like crates, traits, and impls; this is the shared tree-walking logic that other analyses and transformations inherit instead of rewriting full child traversal themselves.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the `rust-ast-visitor` pair: it defines the default recursive walk for `DefaultASTVisitor` and context-stack behavior for `ContextualASTVisitor`, whereas the same-stem header defines the visitor interfaces and class declarations.
